stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: In 15:19:23Z-15:24:23Z checkout recorded STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (increase ~5) and ~5 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on its client operation oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge; both operations also show STATUS_CODE_UNSET series (~5 each), which carry no status and do not prove success.

checkout's own PlaceOrder spans carry the error text 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' with otel.status_code ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code 13, on trace ids 45d914a1f7b6b3058275c18b1c092c05 (span 8c6ef505488cd904), a492177ef70b0d2bf2799bd74b0425c2, 9fe1adc379523188f8d3844b99a78012, 3cb902913ae42c32974586f9b9cbb3a8 and 57ba69daae11077f145135311d0132b1.

The payment service's own server spans (service payment, operation grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge) are recorded as errors with grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and an exception stacktrace originating at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37), on trace ids 45d914a1f7b6b3058275c18b1c092c05 (span c5b9d5a93aa0ba65), a492177ef70b0d2bf2799bd74b0425c2, 9fe1adc379523188f8d3844b99a78012, 3cb902913ae42c32974586f9b9cbb3a8 and 57ba69daae11077f145135311d0132b1; these payment spans lasted about 1.1-11.5 ms.

The elevated checkout errors are caused by the payment service rejecting charges in its own handler: the failing call is checkout's client PaymentService/Charge, and the payment-side span fails with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.' thrown at charge.js:37 rather than timing out or returning a transport error. This makes payment, not checkout's own logic and not checkout's other dependencies, the deepest failing component observed.

The 'Invalid token' rejection may depend on payment input or configuration read at charge time: the payment message includes app.loyalty.level=gold, and payment also emits grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat within the same errored traces. In sampled trace 45d914a1f7b6b3058275c18b1c092c05 that ResolveFloat span returned rpc.grpc.status_code 0, so a flagd evaluation failure is not shown; what the flag value was, or whether it drives the token check, remains unproven.

Latency as the cause of checkout's errors is not supported: checkout's rpc server average was 42.68 ms and its client average 3.07 ms in the window, payment's erroring spans lasted only about 1.1-11.5 ms, and the one-hour-earlier checkout figure is outlier-contaminated rather than a comparable baseline. The failure is an application-level rejection, not a slow dependency.

cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping and email are not supported as the current failing dependency: cart and product-catalog returned 0 error spans in the window, no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned for currency, shipping or email, product-catalog latency was 0.2317 ms versus 0.2142 ms an hour earlier, and in sampled trace 45d914a1f7b6b3058275c18b1c092c05 checkout's prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart span carried no error tags.

Error spans on ad, flagd and recommendation are chronic across the preceding hour (ad, flagd and recommendation oscillating between 0 and about 1.25 per 5-minute bucket from 14:24:23Z onward), so their presence in the last 5 minutes is not evidence that they participate in checkout's charge failures.

gaps: Trace evidence is a projected, sampled and partially truncated view: the checkout trace search returned 509 spans of which one 40-row slice was read (475 rows omitted, truncated true), and the payment trace read returned 151 spans of which 25 rows were read with incomplete true and truncated true, so span counts are not unique request counts and unobserved spans, services and call edges remain unknown.

No server-side latency metric exists for payment, cart, currency, shipping or email (rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count covers only ad, checkout and product-catalog; rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count only ad and checkout), so their latency can only be judged from a biased trace sample, not from a window-wide baseline.

No clean latency baseline for checkout exists: the only earlier comparison window (14:19:23Z-14:24:23Z) has a duration sum increase of 140157.0065 ms over a count increase of 6.25005, dominated by outliers.

What the payment 'invalid token' condition depends on (card token contents, loyalty-level logic, configuration) is unknown; pod logs, kubernetes state and change history are not integrated in this Run, so the deployment or configuration state of payment pod payment-6f7bc865d6-bfxbv during the window was not inspected.

Whether any caller other than the traced frontend path was affected is unverified; frontend, frontend-proxy and load-generator error spans were observed both before and during the window (some chronic), and their error spans were not attributed one-by-one to this cause.
No customer- or business-level impact metric was examined (app_payment_transactions_total has no failure/status label), so the number of failed checkouts is unknown.
